brief: The registered form: a yellowed 1960s typewritten form sheet with printed form lines with black typewritten lines and a blue-black signature, now with a round black postmark stamp and a small red-and-white registered-mail label with a large letter R stuck in the top corner.
edits: 2026-10-06: handwritten date 6. 6. 1960 -> 6. 6. 1962 (Ivanka shown as June 1962, docs/DECISIONS.md); local edit, free: the 0 refilled with the paper of the same rows, a 2 (Ink Free, fitted to the old box, painted halo) written in its place
